metadata.title: Pacific Ocean Currents (globe)
metadata.what_you_will_try: The globe turns as it plays. Can you hear the sound change as warm equatorial water comes into view?

timeline.accessibility_text: Mar 25, 2007: warm surface water averaging 26.0 degrees Celsius (from 7.2 to 31.2), with brisk currents and many swirling eddies. You hear bright tones and quick pulses.
timeline.echo_callout: Pacific Ocean Currents (globe). Each streak is a surface current, coloured from blue at 0 to red at 32 degrees. Listen as the year unfolds.
